title: Fires across the sea
summary: A pyre on every peak of the Aegean. Touch one: every peak that can see it lights its own, and the fire runs from island to island, as the news of Troy reached Argos in a night.

doorway.label: Fires across the sea: a beacon on Mount Ida above Troy
